boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten verified no-admission hangs for University of Rochester students, spanning campus arts, fitness, and nearby public parks and trails.

cards.title: Wander Memorial Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: 500 University Avenue
cards.notes: Bring a valid UR ID, get your free admission ticket online or at the desk, and take an unhurried lap through the galleries together.
cards.short_summary: UR students receive free gallery admission with valid ID.
cards.evidence_claim: Active University of Rochester students always receive free admission with a valid ID.
cards.source_title: For the University of Rochester | Memorial Art Gallery
cards.access_notes: For active UR students; present a valid University ID. Tickets are available online and at the admissions desk.

cards.title: Browse Hartnett Gallery
cards.subtitle: Wilson Commons, 2nd Floor
cards.notes: Meet in Wilson Commons and spend time with the current exhibition; check the gallery calendar before heading over for a reception or talk.
cards.short_summary: A public campus gallery with free exhibitions and presentations.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission to Hartnett Gallery, its receptions, and presentations is free, and the gallery is open to the public.
cards.source_title: Hartnett Gallery | University of Rochester Calendar
cards.access_notes: Located in Wilson Commons on River Campus; exhibitions vary during the academic year.

cards.title: Walk the Sculpture Park
cards.subtitle: Memorial Art Gallery grounds, 500 University Avenue
cards.notes: Use MAG’s digital guide while you circle the outdoor works, then pause at the pieces that give your group something to discuss.
cards.short_summary: Free outdoor public art on the Memorial Art Gallery grounds.
cards.evidence_claim: MAG describes Centennial Sculpture Park as a public art space that is open all the time and free for all.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public art space; MAG says it is open all the time.

cards.title: Join a Group Fitness Class
cards.subtitle: Goergen Athletic Center, River Campus
cards.notes: Check the current semester schedule, then bring a full-time student ID for a class; yoga mats and props are supplied for yoga sessions.
cards.short_summary: Free in-person group fitness classes for eligible full-time students.
cards.evidence_claim: In-person group fitness classes in the Leibner-Cooper Room are free for full-time matriculated students.
cards.source_title: Group Fitness Classes | University of Rochester Athletics and Recreation
cards.access_notes: Available to full-time matriculated students; classes run during the academic year except University holidays.

cards.title: Take a Riverway Walk
cards.subtitle: Trail serves the University of Rochester and runs along the Genesee River
cards.notes: Choose a paved section for a group walk, use the wayfinding signs, and turn back before any steep, rough, or narrow signed sections.
cards.short_summary: A city trail with paved segments, signs, bridges, and river views.
cards.evidence_claim: The City says the Genesee Riverway Trail serves the University of Rochester and is marked to encourage and guide public use.
cards.source_title: Genesee Riverway Trail | City of Rochester
cards.access_notes: City parks and trails are free and open to the public; use signed, accessible portions and follow posted conditions.

cards.title: Rally at Genesee Valley
cards.subtitle: Genesee Valley Park, 131 Elmwood Avenue
cards.notes: Bring racquets and balls, choose an open court, and keep the hang casual; the City lists eight tennis courts at this park.
cards.short_summary: Eight public tennis courts in a large riverside park.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists eight tennis courts at Genesee Valley Park and says its outdoor courts are free to use on a first-come, first-served basis.
cards.source_title: Tennis and pickleball courts | City of Rochester
cards.access_notes: Outdoor courts are public and free on a first-come, first-served basis; equipment is not stated as provided.

cards.title: Hit at Cobb's Hill
cards.subtitle: Cobb's Hill Park, 80 Culver Road
cards.notes: Pack racquets and balls, claim an unreserved court, and pair a short rally with a walk through the surrounding park afterward.
cards.short_summary: Six free public tennis courts at Cobb's Hill Park.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists six tennis courts at Cobb's Hill Park and says its outdoor courts are free to use on a first-come, first-served basis.
cards.source_title: Tennis and pickleball courts | City of Rochester
cards.access_notes: Outdoor courts are public and free on a first-come, first-served basis; equipment is not stated as provided.

cards.title: Stroll Highland Park
cards.subtitle: 450 Highland Avenue
cards.notes: Pick a route through the arboretum, gardens, and paths, then stop at a bench or picnic area for a low-key conversation outdoors.
cards.short_summary: A landscaped city park with paths, benches, gardens, and picnic areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists Highland Park’s hiking paths, benches, gardens, and picnic areas among its amenities.
cards.access_notes: City parks are free and open to the public; this applies to the park grounds, not separately operated attractions or rentals.

cards.title: Walk Washington Grove
cards.subtitle: Beside Cobb's Hill Reservoir
cards.notes: Stay on the winding trails, keep bikes out of the grove, and keep dogs leashed if one joins your group for the walk.
cards.short_summary: A 100-acre old-growth forest sanctuary with hiking trails.
cards.evidence_claim: The City describes Washington Grove as a 100-acre sanctuary with hiking trails and states that bikes are prohibited and dogs must be leashed.
cards.source_title: Cobb's Hill Park and Washington Grove | City of Rochester
cards.access_notes: City parks are free and open to the public; follow the grove’s trail rules, including no bicycles.

cards.title: Visit the Maplewood Rose Garden
cards.subtitle: Maplewood Park, 250 Maplewood Avenue
cards.notes: Walk through the rose garden and nearby Riverway Trail, then use the open space for a relaxed outdoor catch-up without booking a facility.
cards.short_summary: A city park and rose garden beside the Genesee Riverway Trail.
cards.evidence_claim: The City identifies Maplewood Park’s Rose Garden and the Genesee Riverway Trail as features of this park.
cards.source_title: Maplewood Park and Rose Garden | City of Rochester
cards.access_notes: City parks are free and open to the public; facility reservations and formal ceremonies may have separate requirements.
